value.rationale: At fixed synchronization-optimal cardinality, Hamming distance is a natural robustness invariant: Chee et al. explicitly motivate Hamming-neighborhood matching for synchronization under symbol errors. The refinement is sharp and highly selective—only four of 1,152 maxima avoid distance-one pairs—and it gives a complete symmetry classification of the robust equality cases. This is a motivated finite boundary fact rather than a routine recomputation of the known size 14.
